translations.literal: Houmo Chencheng with fierce and bold spirit, in war's advantage, light cavalry opened Gaoping's gate, and a single horse won Changkeng's victory.
translations.idiomatic: Houmo Chencheng, with fierce boldness and the advantage of war, opened Gaoping with light cavalry and won Changkeng with a single horse.

sentences.zh: 竝以宏材遠略，附鳳攀龍，績著元勳，位居上衮。

translations.literal: All with great talent and far-reaching design, attached to phoenix and climbed dragon, merit marked primal achievement, and position reached highest ministerial rank.
translations.idiomatic: All possessed great talent and far-reaching design; attaching themselves to the rising sovereign, they won founding merit and reached the highest ministerial rank.

sentences.zh: 而識慚明悊，咸以凶終，惜哉！

translations.literal: Yet in wisdom ashamed of clear judgment, all met violent ends—alas!
translations.idiomatic: Yet they lacked the discernment to end well—all died violently. Pity!

sentences.zh: 信雖不免其身，慶延于後。

translations.literal: Though Xin did not preserve his person, blessing extended to posterity.
translations.idiomatic: Though Du Guxin did not preserve his own life, blessing extended to his posterity.

sentences.zh: 三代外戚，何其盛歟。

translations.literal: Three generations of consort kin—how flourishing!
translations.idiomatic: Three generations of consort kin—how flourishing indeed!

sentences.zh: 初，魏孝莊帝以爾朱榮有翊戴之功，拜榮柱國大將軍，位在丞相上。

translations.literal: Initially Emperor Xiaozhuang of Wei, because Erzhu Rong had supporting merit, appointed Rong Pillar Grand General with rank above the Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: Initially Emperor Xiaozhuang of Wei, because Erzhu Rong had merit in supporting the throne, appointed him pillar grand general with rank above the chancellor.

sentences.zh: 榮敗後，此官遂廢。

translations.literal: After Rong's defeat this office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: After Erzhu Rong's defeat the office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 大統三年，魏文帝復以太祖建中興之業，始命為之。

translations.literal: In the third year of Datong, Emperor Wen of Wei again, because Grand Progenitor built the restoration enterprise, first appointed him to it.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Datong (537), Emperor Wen of Wei again, because Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai had built the restoration enterprise, first appointed him to the office.

sentences.zh: 其後功參佐命，望實俱重者，亦居此職。

translations.literal: Thereafter those whose merit joined in assisting the mandate and whose reputation and substance were both weighty also held this post.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter those whose merit shared in founding the mandate and whose reputation and substance were both weighty also held this post.

sentences.zh: 自大統十六年以前，任者凡有八人。

translations.literal: From before the sixteenth year of Datong, holders totaled eight men.
translations.idiomatic: Before the sixteenth year of Datong (550), there were eight holders in all.

sentences.zh: 太祖位總百揆，督中外軍。

translations.literal: Grand Progenitor's position summarized the hundred affairs and supervised the central and external armies.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai's position summarized all state affairs and supervised the central and external armies.

sentences.zh: 魏廣陵王欣，元氏懿戚，從容禁闈而已。

translations.literal: Prince Yuan Xin of Guangling of Wei, an honored kinsman of the Yuan clan, merely moved at ease within the forbidden quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yuan Xin of Guangling of Wei, an honored kinsman of the Yuan clan, merely moved at ease within the palace precincts.

sentences.zh: 此外六人，各督二大將軍，分掌禁旅，當爪牙禦侮之寄。

translations.literal: Besides these six men, each supervised two grand generals, divided command of the forbidden troops, and held the charge of fang and claw in defense against insult.
translations.idiomatic: Besides these six men, each supervised two grand generals, divided command of the palace guard, and held the charge of fang and claw in defense against insult.

sentences.zh: 當時榮盛，莫與為比。

translations.literal: At that time the glory and splendor had none to compare.
translations.idiomatic: At that time their glory and splendor had no equal.

sentences.zh: 故今之稱門閥者，咸推八柱國家云。

translations.literal: Therefore those today called gate-and-clan families all esteem the Eight Pillars families.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore families today called great clans all esteem the Eight Pillars houses.

sentences.zh: 今幷十二大將軍錄之於左。

translations.literal: Now the Twelve Grand Generals are also recorded at left.
translations.idiomatic: The Twelve Senior Generals are also recorded below.

sentences.zh: 使持節、太尉、柱國大將軍、大都督、尚書左僕射、隴右行臺、少師、隴西郡開國公李虎，

translations.literal: Commissioner with full credentials, Grand Commandant, Pillar Grand General, Grand Commander, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, Longyou Mobile Headquarters, Junior Preceptor, state-opening Duke of Longxi commandery Li Hu,
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner with full credentials, grand commandant, pillar grand general, grand commander, left vice director of the masters of writing, Longyou mobile headquarters, junior preceptor, state-opening Duke of Longxi — Li Hu,

sentences.zh: 使持節、太傅、柱國大將軍、大宗伯、大司徒、廣陵王元欣，

translations.literal: Commissioner with full credentials, Grand Preceptor, Pillar Grand General, Grand Minister of Ritual, Grand Minister of Education, Prince of Guangling Yuan Xin,
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner with full credentials, grand preceptor, pillar grand general, grand minister of ritual, grand minister of education, Prince of Guangling — Yuan Xin,

sentences.zh: 使持節、太保、柱國大將軍、大都督、大宗伯、趙郡開國公李弼，

translations.literal: Commissioner with full credentials, Grand Guardian, Pillar Grand General, Grand Commander, Grand Minister of Ritual, state-opening Duke of Zhao commandery Li Bi,
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner with full credentials, grand guardian, pillar grand general, grand commander, grand minister of ritual, state-opening Duke of Zhao — Li Bi,

sentences.zh: 使持節、柱國大將軍、大都督、大司馬、河內郡開國公獨孤信，

translations.literal: Commissioner with full credentials, Pillar Grand General, Grand Commander, Grand Minister of War, state-opening Duke of Henei commandery Du Guxin,
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner with full credentials, pillar grand general, grand commander, grand minister of war, state-opening Duke of Henei — Du Guxin,

sentences.zh: 使持節、柱國大將軍、大都督、大司寇、南陽郡開國公趙貴，

translations.literal: Commissioner with full credentials, Pillar Grand General, Grand Commander, Grand Minister of Justice, state-opening Duke of Nanyang commandery Zhao Gui,
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner with full credentials, pillar grand general, grand commander, grand minister of justice, state-opening Duke of Nanyang — Zhao Gui,

sentences.zh: 使持節、柱國大將軍、大都督、大司空、常山郡開國公于謹，

translations.literal: Commissioner with full credentials, Pillar Grand General, Grand Commander, Grand Minister of Works, state-opening Duke of Changshan commandery Yu Jin,
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner with full credentials, pillar grand general, grand commander, grand minister of works, state-opening Duke of Changshan — Yu Jin,

sentences.zh: 使持節、柱國大將軍、大都督、少傅、彭城郡開國公侯莫陳崇。

translations.literal: Commissioner with full credentials, Pillar Grand General, Grand Commander, Junior Mentor, state-opening Duke of Pengcheng commandery Houmo Chencheng.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner with full credentials, pillar grand general, grand commander, junior mentor, state-opening Duke of Pengcheng — Houmo Chencheng.

sentences.zh: 右與太祖為八柱國。

translations.literal: Those at right with Grand Progenitor made the Eight Pillars.
translations.idiomatic: Those listed at right, together with Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai, made the Eight Pillars.

sentences.zh: （後竝改封，此竝太祖時爵。）

translations.literal: (All were later given changed enfeoffments; these are all titles from Grand Progenitor's time.)
translations.idiomatic: [All were later given new enfeoffments; these titles date from Grand Progenitor Yuwen Tai's time.]

sentences.zh: 使持節、大將軍、大都督、少保、廣平王元贊，

translations.literal: Commissioner with full credentials, Grand General, Grand Commander, Junior Guardian, Prince of Guangping Yuan Zan,
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner with full credentials, grand general, grand commander, junior guardian, Prince of Guangping — Yuan Zan,

sentences.zh: 使持節、大將軍、大都督、淮

translations.literal: Commissioner with full credentials, Grand General, Grand Commander, Huai
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner with full credentials, grand general, grand commander, Prince of Huai

translations.literal: (An)
translations.idiomatic: [An — completing Huai'an]

sentences.zh: 王元育，

translations.literal: Prince Yuan Yu,
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yuan Yu,

sentences.zh: 使持節、大將軍、大都督、齊王元廓，

translations.literal: Commissioner with full credentials, Grand General, Grand Commander, Prince of Qi Yuan Kuo,
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner with full credentials, grand general, grand commander, Prince of Qi — Yuan Kuo,

sentences.zh: 使持節、大將軍、大都督、秦七州諸軍事、秦州刺史、章武郡開國公宇文導，

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff, Grand General, Great Governor-General, Military Affairs in the Seven Qin Provinces, Governor of Qin Province, and Founding Duke of Zhangwu commandery, Yuwen Dao,
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Dao — bearer of the staff, grand general and great governor-general of military affairs in the seven Qin provinces, governor of Qin Province, and founding duke of Zhangwu commandery,

sentences.zh: 使持節、大將軍、大都督、平原郡開國公侯莫陳順，

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff, Grand General, Great Governor-General, and Founding Duke of Pingyuan commandery, Houmo Chen Shun,
translations.idiomatic: Houmo Chen Shun — bearer of the staff, grand general, great governor-general, and founding duke of Pingyuan commandery,

sentences.zh: 使持節、大將軍、大都督、雍七州諸軍事、雍州刺史、高陽郡開國公達奚武，

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff, Grand General, Great Governor-General, Military Affairs in the Seven Yong Provinces, Governor of Yong Province, and Founding Duke of Gaoyang commandery, Daxi Wu,
translations.idiomatic: Daxi Wu — bearer of the staff, grand general and great governor-general of military affairs in the seven Yong provinces, governor of Yong Province, and founding duke of Gaoyang commandery,

sentences.zh: 使持節、大將軍、大都督、陽平公李遠，

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff, Grand General, Great Governor-General, and Duke of Yangping Li Yuan,
translations.idiomatic: Li Yuan — bearer of the staff, grand general, great governor-general, and duke of Yangping,

sentences.zh: 使持節、大將軍、大都督、范陽郡開國公豆盧寧，

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff, Grand General, Great Governor-General, and Founding Duke of Fanyang commandery, Doulu Ning,
translations.idiomatic: Doulu Ning — bearer of the staff, grand general, great governor-general, and founding duke of Fanyang commandery,

sentences.zh: 使持節、大將軍、大都督、化政郡開國公宇文貴，

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff, Grand General, Great Governor-General, and Founding Duke of Huazheng commandery, Yuwen Gui,
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Gui — bearer of the staff, grand general, great governor-general, and founding duke of Huazheng commandery,

sentences.zh: 使持節、大將軍、大都督、荊州諸軍事、荊州刺史、博陵郡開國公賀蘭祥，

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff, Grand General, Great Governor-General, Military Affairs in Jing Province, Governor of Jing Province, and Founding Duke of Boling commandery, Helan Xiang,
translations.idiomatic: Helan Xiang — bearer of the staff, grand general and great governor-general of military affairs in Jing Province, governor of Jing Province, and founding duke of Boling commandery,

sentences.zh: 使持節、大將軍、大都督、陳留郡開國公楊忠，

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff, Grand General, Great Governor-General, and Founding Duke of Chenliu commandery, Yang Zhong,
translations.idiomatic: Yang Zhong — bearer of the staff, grand general, great governor-general, and founding duke of Chenliu commandery,

sentences.zh: 使持節、大將軍、大都督、岐州諸軍事、岐州刺史、武威郡開國公王雄。

translations.literal: Bearer of the Staff, Grand General, Great Governor-General, Military Affairs in Qi Province, Governor of Qi Province, and Founding Duke of Wuwei commandery, Wang Xiong.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xiong — bearer of the staff, grand general and great governor-general of military affairs in Qi Province, governor of Qi Province, and founding duke of Wuwei commandery.

sentences.zh: 右十二大將軍，又各統開府二人。

translations.literal: The twelve grand generals listed at right each also commanded two opening offices.
translations.idiomatic: These twelve grand generals each also commanded two opening offices.

sentences.zh: 每一開府領一軍兵，是為二十四軍。

translations.literal: Each opening office led the soldiers of one army; this constituted the twenty-four armies.
translations.idiomatic: Each opening office led one army—twenty-four armies in all.

sentences.zh: 自大統十六年以前，十二大將軍外，念賢及王思政亦作大將軍。

translations.literal: Before the sixteenth year of Datong, beyond the twelve grand generals, Nian Xian and Wang Sizheng also held the rank of grand general.
translations.idiomatic: Before the sixteenth year of Datong (550), besides the twelve grand generals, Nian Xian and Wang Sizheng also held the rank of grand general.

sentences.zh: 然賢作牧隴右，思政出鎮河南，竝不在領兵之限。

translations.literal: Yet Xian served as governor of Longyou, and Sizheng went out to garrison Henan; both were outside the limit of command over troops.
translations.idiomatic: But Nian Xian governed Longyou and Wang Sizheng held Henan; neither fell within the roster of troop commanders.

sentences.zh: 此後功臣，位至柱國及大將軍者衆矣，咸是散秩，無所統御。

translations.literal: After this the meritorious men who reached pillar-of-state and grand general were very many; all were nominal ranks with nothing to command.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward many meritorious men reached pillar-of-state or grand general, but these were all nominal ranks with no troops under command.

sentences.zh: 六柱國、十二大將軍之後，有以位次嗣掌其事者，而德望素在諸公之，不得預於此列。

translations.literal: After the six pillars-of-state and twelve grand generals, there were successors who held the posts in order of rank, yet whose virtue and standing had always been below the original lords and who could not be counted in this roster.
translations.idiomatic: After the six pillars-of-state and twelve grand generals, successors inherited the posts by seniority, but their standing had always been below these original lords and they could not be counted among them.

sentences.zh: 全文以中華書局、一九七一年十一月版《周書》為本校。
